bio.text: Gary Dye is the Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. Senate in Oregon in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Ballotpedia reports he was born in Portland, Oregon, studied at Oregon State University, Pepperdine University and the University of California, Irvine, and earned a master's degree from Pepperdine in 1989.
It reports his professional experience includes work as a chemical engineer and measurement engineer in the natural gas industry and as a process engineer in oil refineries.
